title: Featured projects move up front
summary:
Featured projects got a better spot on the homepage, two community additions joined the showcase, and Unity’s image instructions now point to flux.

The homepage now places Projects ahead of Integrations and adds a “For Teens 🚀” tab drawn from featured projects across existing categories. Creative & Interactive Applications is now called Creative Apps. The same update broadened mature-content screening and removed an external homepage script.

The project listings gained @fqueis’s TypeScript Node.js client for images, text, and speech, plus @sugamdeol’s CalcuBite AI, which estimates nutrition from food photos.

The Unity persona now directs image generation through flux instead of the Unity model, with expanded guidance for image styles.

highlights.title: Featured projects for teens
highlights.text: Explore the new “For Teens 🚀” tab in Projects, now placed higher on the homepage.

highlights.title: A community Node.js client
highlights.text: Find a TypeScript client for image generation, text processing, and speech synthesis in the SDK and libraries showcase. It supports CJS and ESM modules, plus feeds and streams.
